name: CloseButton
description: A material design close button. Typically used to close dialogs, pages, or other overlay widgets.

properties.name: onPressed
properties.description: Callback function called when the button is tapped. If null, the button is disabled.

properties.name: color
properties.description: The color to use for the close icon.

properties.name: key
properties.description: An optional identifier for this widget.
